annotations.title: Add or remove labels on many items

description:
[writes flayr data · `write` scope] Adds and/or removes labels on up to 100 content items in one call: each item becomes (labels − remove) + add. Published items are fine (labels are metadata). Each item succeeds or fails on its own; read `results`. Removing `source:ai-generated` does not turn a post's AI label off: with no explicit toggle it follows how the media was made, and the result carries a `warning`. For real footage also call update_content with `aiGenerated: false` on each item.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/content/labels.)

add.description: Labels to add. Normalized "key:value" labels (keys and values are lower-cased, spaces become "-"). Linked keys: campaign:<media campaign id>, experiment:<experiment id> (+ variant:<name> or the experiment's compareKey), type:<post type> (short, long-form, carousel, image, text, reel, story, poem, timelapse…). Free keys work too: cut:opus, lane:tech, parent:pantheon-part-1, ab:<pair id> (an A/B pair). Labels are copied onto every post made from the draft, and compared in GET /api/v2/analytics/experiments.

remove.description: Labels to remove. Not also in `add`.
